name: Thinkific
summary: A course and learning-commerce platform for creators and organisations to build, sell and run branded courses, communities and memberships, with an enterprise tier (Thinkific Plus) for external-audience training.

value: Quizzes, assignments, completion certificates and course compliance tools on every plan
In-course discussions and communities (1, 3 or 10 communities by plan; unlimited on Plus)
Memberships, subscriptions, payment plans, bundles and order bumps
Coupons, affiliate reporting and email automation
Reporting and analytics from Grow; advanced reporting on Plus
API, webhooks and bulk enrolment from Grow
Exams with attempt limits, learning paths, SSO, SCORM and an AI teaching assistant on Thinkific Plus

value.from: US$82 a month billed annually, or US$109 monthly (Start)
value.notes: Grow is US$164 a month billed annually (US$219 monthly) and Expand US$374 (US$499 monthly); Thinkific Plus is quoted. Start, Grow and Expand allow up to 10,000 current students. Thinkific Payments charges 2.9% processing; a Branded Mobile App add-on is US$199 a month.

value.standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (working towards, by its own statement)
value.evidence: Vendor statement reviewed April 2026: independent third-party audit of the learner experience, testing with disabled participants through Fable, known gaps in creator and admin areas. VPAT/ACR on the roadmap, not yet published.

value.australianPrivacyAct: Customer and learner data is hosted in the United States; Australian organisations should assess cross-border disclosure under the Privacy Act 1988.
value.notes: Production systems in the US; AWS and Google listed as customer-data storage subprocessors.

Privacy policy says AI inputs and outputs are used to provide features and not to train models or shared across customers. Third-party AI providers are named in the subprocessor list; specific models are not.
